sections.title: 二、用所给单词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入句中空白处。

questions.prompt: 1. Miss Wang never ______ junk food. She ______ it is harmful to her health. (eat, think)
questions.translation: 王老师从不吃垃圾食品。她认为这对她的健康有害。
questions.explanation: 主语 Miss Wang 和 She 均为第三人称单数，根据 never 和 is 可知句子为一般现在时，谓语动词均用第三人称单数形式 eats 和 thinks。故选 eats; thinks。

questions.prompt: 2. It ______ outside. Please take your raincoat. (snow)
questions.translation: 外面正在下雪。请带上你的雨衣。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“请带上你的雨衣”可知外面此时正在下雪，应用现在进行时 is snowing。故选 is snowing。

questions.prompt: 3. We ______ a new house for the poor family next year. (build)
questions.translation: 我们明年将为这个贫困家庭建造一座新房子。
questions.explanation: 根据时间状语 next year 可知句子应用一般将来时 will build。故选 will build。

questions.prompt: 4. Spring is coming. It will ______ warmer and warmer. (become)
questions.translation: 春天来了。天气将变得越来越暖和。
questions.explanation: 助动词 will 后面必须接动词原形 become。故选 become。

questions.prompt: 5. My watch is very cheap. I ______ it online. (buy)
questions.translation: 我的手表很便宜。我是网上买的。
questions.explanation: 手表已经买到了，买手表的动作发生在过去，应用一般过去时 bought。故选 bought。

sections.title: 三、单项选择
sections.instruction: 从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. Let Li Ming ______ you ______ the books to the classroom.
questions.translation: 让李明帮你把书拿到教室去吧。
questions.explanation: let sb. do sth. 让某人做某事，第一空用动词原形 help；help sb. (to) do sth. 帮助某人做某事，第二空用动词原形 take。故选 help; take。

questions.prompt: 2. I am hungry. I'd like to have some ______.
questions.translation: 我饿了。我想吃点米饭。
questions.explanation: some 后接不可数名词或可数名词复数。sandwich, dumpling, egg 均为可数名词单数形式，rice 为不可数名词。故选 rice。

questions.prompt: 3. Tom and I ______ doing ______ homework now.
questions.translation: 汤姆和我现在正在做我们的作业。
questions.explanation: 主语 Tom and I 为复数，be 动词用 are；对应的人称是第一人称复数 we，形容词性物主代词用 our。故选 are; our。

questions.prompt: 4. Michael is not a ______ basketball player, so he doesn't play basketball ______.
questions.translation: 迈克尔不是一个优秀的篮球运动员，所以他篮球打得不好。
questions.explanation: 第一空修饰名词短语 basketball player 用形容词 good；第二空修饰动词短语 play basketball 用副词 well。故选 good; well。

questions.prompt: 5. You ______ return the book now. You can keep it until next week if you like.
questions.translation: 你现在不必还书。如果你喜欢，你可以借到下周。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“如果你喜欢，你可以借到下周”可知现在“不必”还书，needn't 表示不必。故选 needn't。

questions.prompt: 6. My mother asked me ______ in bed.
questions.translation: 我妈妈叫我不要在床上看书。
questions.explanation: ask sb. not to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“要求某人不要做某事”，应用动词不定式的否定形式 not to read。故选 not to read。

questions.prompt:
7. —______ is it from your home to the cinema?
—It's about twenty minutes' walk.
questions.translation:
——从你家到电影院有多远？
——步行大约二十分钟的路程。
questions.explanation: 答语“步行大约二十分钟的路程”表示距离路程，对两地距离提问用疑问短语 How far。故选 How far。

questions.prompt:
8. —How many students are there in your school?
—About six ______.
questions.translation:
——你们学校有多少名学生？
——大约六百名。
questions.explanation: 具体基数词（如 six）后接 hundred 时用单数形式，且不加 of，six hundred 表示六百。故选 hundred。

questions.prompt:
9. —How is your father feeling today?
—Much ______. He can't go to work today.
questions.translation:
——你父亲今天感觉怎么样？
——严重多了。他今天不能去上班。
questions.explanation: much 修饰形容词比较级；根据后文“他今天不能去上班”可知病情更严重了，用 bad 的比较级 worse。故选 worse。

questions.prompt:
10. —I'll go to Japan for a holiday next month.
—______
questions.translation:
——我下个月要去日本度假。
——祝你玩得开心！
questions.explanation: 听到对方要去度假时，礼貌用语通常表达祝愿玩得愉快，用 Have a good time!。故选 Have a good time!。

sections.title: 五、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，掌握其大意，然后从各题所给的 A、B、C 三个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage: On Sundays we often go to the [1] near our school. There are many [2] in it—tigers, elephants, pandas and monkeys. The [3] are very big. They all have [4] noses. Their noses can [5] them eat and drink. [6] are very ferocious (凶猛的). They often run [7] in the zoo. Many people like [8]. They are animals of China. But I like monkeys best. We like [9] to the zoo. We can [10] more animals there.

questions.translation: 周日我们经常去学校附近的动物园。
questions.explanation: 根据后文列举的老虎、大象、熊猫和猴子等动物可知是去动物园 (zoo)。故选 zoo。

questions.translation: 里面有许多动物——老虎、大象、熊猫和猴子。
questions.explanation: tigers, elephants, pandas and monkeys 都属于动物 (animals)。故选 animals。

questions.translation: 大象非常大。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“They all have... noses. Their noses can... them eat and drink.”可知是指大象 (elephants)。故选 elephants。

questions.translation: 它们都有长长的鼻子。
questions.explanation: 大象的鼻子是长长的 (long)。故选 long。

questions.translation: 它们的鼻子可以帮助它们吃喝。
questions.explanation: help sb. (to) do sth. 帮助某人做某事，大象的长鼻子可以“帮助 (help)”它们吃东西和喝水。故选 help。

questions.translation: 老虎非常凶猛。
questions.explanation: 根据 ferocious (凶猛的) 以及常识可知是指老虎 (Tigers)。故选 Tigers。

questions.translation: 它们经常在动物园里奔跑玩耍。
questions.explanation: run and play / run play 描述动物奔跑玩耍的动态。故选 play。

questions.translation: 许多人喜欢大熊猫。它们是中国的国宝动物。
questions.explanation: 根据“They are animals of China.”可知是指中国的代表动物大熊猫 (pandas)。故选 pandas。

questions.translation: 我们喜欢去动物园。
questions.explanation: like doing sth. 喜欢做某事，此处使用动名词 going。故选 going。

questions.translation: 我们可以在那里看到更多的动物。
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形，在动物园可以“看到 (see)”更多动物。故选 see。

sections.title: 六、阅读理解 A (判断正误)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，判断下列句子正(T)误(F)。
sections.passage:
My grandpa and I are schoolmates. He graduated from the school 57 years ago.

My grandpa shows me lots of pictures of his school in his album.

It was a small school with an old gate. There was only one house in the school. All the students studied in the same classroom. There was no playground. They chased each other in the field. There was no swimming pool. They swam in a river. They were very happy.

But it is different now. The school is bigger. There is a big playground, a swimming pool and a big gym. We can play sports every day. We have a new library. We can read books on Fridays. We have Chinese, maths, English, science, PE and so on. We are happy, too.

questions.prompt: 1. My grandpa and I are schoolmates.
questions.translation: 我爷爷和我是校友。
questions.explanation: 根据短文第一句“My grandpa and I are schoolmates.”可知陈述正确。

questions.prompt: 2. Before, students could swim in the swimming pool.
questions.translation: 以前，学生们可以在游泳池里游泳。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段中“There was no swimming pool. They swam in a river.”可知过去没有游泳池，他们在河里游泳，因此陈述错误。

questions.prompt: 3. Before, students had many different subjects.
questions.translation: 以前，学生们有许多不同的科目。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“All the students studied in the same classroom.”及第四段中描述现在的学校才开设了多门不同科目可知过去并没有这么多科目，陈述错误。

questions.prompt: 4. There is a big gym now.
questions.translation: 现在有一个大体育馆。
questions.explanation: 根据第四段中“There is a big playground, a swimming pool and a big gym.”可知陈述正确。

questions.prompt: 5. Our school is full of happiness then and now.
questions.translation: 无论过去还是现在，我们的学校都充满快乐。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段最后一句“They were very happy.”和第四段最后一句“We are happy, too.”可知过去和现在的校园生活都充满快乐，陈述正确。

sections.title: 七、任务型阅读 (一) - 故事图片排序
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据故事情节发展，用数字 1-4 将下列图片按先后顺序排序。
sections.passage:
Tom had a young donkey and an old donkey. One day, Tom went a long way to the town with the donkeys. He bought some cotton and salt. He put the cotton in a big bag and the salt in a small bag.

The young donkey was smart but lazy. It knew that cotton was lighter, so it said, "I'm strong. I can carry the big bag."

"OK. I'll carry the salt then," said the old donkey.

On their way home, the young donkey walked very fast. The old donkey could only walk very slowly with the heavy bag of salt.

Suddenly, it started to rain heavily. The cotton got wet and became heavier. The young donkey could not walk fast. At last, the young donkey could not walk and rested under the tree. But the old donkey found that its bag became lighter. And it walked fast then.

sections.title: 八、任务型阅读 (二) - 回答问题
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Tom had a young donkey and an old donkey. One day, Tom went a long way to the town with the donkeys. He bought some cotton and salt. He put the cotton in a big bag and the salt in a small bag.

The young donkey was smart but lazy. It knew that cotton was lighter, so it said, "I'm strong. I can carry the big bag."

"OK. I'll carry the salt then," said the old donkey.

On their way home, the young donkey walked very fast. The old donkey could only walk very slowly with the heavy bag of salt.

Suddenly, it started to rain heavily. The cotton got wet and became heavier. The young donkey could not walk fast. At last, the young donkey could not walk and rested under the tree. But the old donkey found that its bag became lighter. And it walked fast then.

questions.prompt: 1. What was the young donkey like?
questions.translation: 年轻的小毛驴是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“The young donkey was smart but lazy.”可知，年轻的毛驴聪明但很懒惰。故选 It was smart but lazy.。

questions.prompt: 2. Which bag was heavier at first, the big one or the small one?
questions.translation: 起初哪个袋子更重，大袋子还是小袋子？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“It knew that cotton was lighter...”以及第四段“The old donkey could only walk very slowly with the heavy bag of salt.”可知，小袋子装的是盐，一开始更重。故选 The small one (with salt).。

questions.prompt: 3. Why did the old donkey walk fast after it rained heavily?
options: Because the salt in its bag dissolved in water and became lighter.
Because the cotton in its bag dried quickly.
Because it wanted to rest under the leafy tree.
Because Tom helped it carry the heavy bag.
questions.translation: 下大雨后老毛驴为什么走得快了？
questions.explanation: 根据常识及文章最后一段可知，雨水溶解了盐，使老毛驴背的袋子变轻了，所以它走得快了。故选 Because the salt in its bag dissolved in water and became lighter.。
